page.overview:
What is Broom care station?

A broom care station was a workstation where broomstick maintenance could be performed. They were equipped to perform tasks such as trimming loose twigs and applying wax and polish. Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry owned a number of broom care stations which were used during Flying classes to teach students about broom care and maintenance.
